name.ja: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT TIGA SKY TYPE -ACTION-
name.en: Figure-rise Standard ULTRAMAN SUIT TIGA SKY TYPE -ACTION-

description.ja: 月刊ホビージャパン連載の『ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE』より、ティガスーツの人気バリエーションタイプ「ティガスーツ スカイタイプ」を-ACTION-シリーズで商品化！
description.en: From "ULTRAMAN SUIT ANOTHER UNIVERSE " serialized in Hobby Japan, the popular variation type of Tiga suit " Tiga Suit Sky Type" is commercialized in the -ACTION- series!

description.ja: ■清水先生×下口先生描きおろしデザインのスラスターは、側面と背面のパーツに可動ギミックを搭載。
description.en: • The thruster designed by Mr. Shimizu and Mr. Shimoguchi is equipped with movable gimmicks on the side and back parts.

description.ja: ■腹部および首関節パーツを-ACTION-仕様に形状を改善し、可動範囲を拡大。
description.en: • The shape of the abdominal and neck joint parts has been improved to -ACTION- specifications and the range of motion has been expanded.

description.ja: ■広範囲な可動域で必殺技ゼペリオン光線の構えポーズを再現可能。
description.en: • A wide range of motion allows you to recreate the stance pose of the special move Zeperion Ray.

description.ja: ■プラモデルオリジナル武器のゼペリオンスピアはクリアパーツで付属。
description.en: • Zeperion Spear, a plastic model original weapon, is included as a clear part.

description.ja: ■LEDユニット（別売り）を胸部に収め、胸と目を光らせることができる。
description.en: • An LED unit (sold separately) can be placed in the chest to make the chest and eyes shine.
